evidence_limit: Authored translation and offline runtime contracts. Scalar SELECT categories, dynamic narrow variables and virtual-volume rename batches do not establish native source acceptance, ABI, storage formats, physical filesystems or controller behavior.

scalar_select.categories: Finite INTEGER/BYTE/SHORT/REAL numeric values, BOOLEAN or bounded ASCII STRING; BOOLEAN is never a numeric case
scalar_select.matching: Evaluate selector once, compare compatible compile-time cases in source order using ordinary numeric or exact string/Boolean equality, execute only the first matching clause
scalar_select.control: Structured, labelled and cooperative execution retain ordinary no-match errors, explicit empty ELSE, source locations, effects and frame cleanup
scalar_select.boundary: No dynamic cases, category coercion, aggregate/resource selectors or native extension claim; legacy SELECT remains integer-only

dynamic_narrow.creation: Direct BYTE/SHORT names and transparent supplied aliases create scalar storage or existing dimensioned forms in an explicit logical variable store
dynamic_narrow.storage: Preserve BYTE unknown contents, SHORT uninitialized/32767 semantics, exact BYNAME references, checked numeric domains and existing group/memory-pool metadata
dynamic_narrow.preflight: Retain duplicate/name/type/group/dimension/budget and combined 32767-leaf checks before allocation; saved metadata, marker and archive validation use existing contracts
dynamic_narrow.boundary: No BYTE UNINIT, numeric reinterpretation through BYNAME, resource creation, native memory allocation or public strict mode

cross_volume_rename.scope: Bounded wildcard RENAME_FILE between configured mounted writable volumes within one supplied DeviceFiles bank
cross_volume_rename.preflight: Prepare all final file keys and source retained garbage; validate no-overwrite, aliases/overlap, handles, paths, metadata, execution budget, final file count and each volume's complete live-plus-garbage capacity before publication
cross_volume_rename.publication: Move original payload objects while preserving file dictionary and volume-row identities; publish prepared file keys and garbage without callbacks or checkpoints between them
cross_volume_rename.retention: Cross-volume source retain_deleted adds moved byte lengths to garbage; nonretaining sources free moved bytes; destination existing garbage remains charged; same-volume renames need no copy capacity
cross_volume_rename.boundary: No cross-bank/PIP-to-ordinary moves, host cross-filesystem transaction, implicit volume discovery or native status/physical storage claim

strict_mode: Future milestone; preserve legacy restrictions and historical semantic ledgers
